text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин hasn't shown up for
training
today, so I decide to go looking
for her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
My megaphone is ready to go! Now, to
the
baseball stadium!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Ahem... Trainer, what a surprise. I was
just on my
way out.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: Did you forget about your training?

text_block_list.text:
O-o-oh nooo... I, of all people! I've been
thinking
so much about the consecutive
hits record that I...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: Just be more careful next time.

text_block_list.text:
Yes... I shall practice self-discipline and
recover
from this blunder!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
